showCreateOnBrowse.label: Insert SHOW CREATE output into the editor when browsing a table/view
showCreateOnBrowse.description: When you browse a table or view, inserts its SHOW CREATE (DDL) output into the SQL editor.

defaultLimit.label: Default row limit
defaultLimit.description: Default row cap applied to SELECTs that have no LIMIT of their own; applies to newly opened sessions and can be overridden live per session from the status bar.

editorWrap.label: Word-wrap the SQL editor by default
editorWrap.description: Turns on word-wrap in the SQL editor for newly opened editors; can be toggled live per editor via the word-wrap shortcut or View menu.

copyHeaders.label: Include column headers when copying cells
copyHeaders.description: Includes the column header row when copying cells from a result grid; can also be toggled with a shortcut.

editorKeywordCase.label: SQL keyword case
editorKeywordCase.description: Controls the case that autocompletion inserts for SQL keywords (SELECT vs select); formatting itself follows the active formatting profile.

editorMinimap.label: Editor minimap
editorMinimap.description: Shows the code minimap (line-density map with viewport and search markers) beside the SQL editor; toggles live.

editorAutoFormat.label: Auto-format SQL
editorAutoFormat.description: Controls when the built-in beautifier auto-formats SQL in the editor: never, when a semicolon completes a statement, or after pasting SQL. Strings, quoted identifiers and comments are never touched.

writeConfirm.label: Confirm writes
writeConfirm.description: Controls when the write-confirmation window (showing the statement and affected-row count) appears before running a write.
writeConfirm.values: 'destructive' (UPDATE/DELETE always, others on prod), 'always' (every write), or 'prod' (only on prod, or a write with no WHERE)

appFontSize.label: Font size (app-wide; the grid has its own Aa popover)
appFontSize.description: App-wide base font size in pixels; the result grid has its own separate font controls in its Aa popover.
appFontSize.values: integer px, clamped to the 10-20 range (FONT_SIZE_MIN-FONT_SIZE_MAX)

exportEol.label: Line endings in exported files
exportEol.description: Line endings written into exported text files (not the clipboard, which is left untouched).

qualityDetail.label: (not surfaced in SettingsModal)
qualityDetail.section: Not shown in Settings UI (set elsewhere, e.g. the SQL Quality report view)
qualityDetail.description: How verbose a SQL Quality report is; the same findings can be rendered at five depths, applying to both the screen and exports.

qualityFloor.label: (not surfaced in SettingsModal)
qualityFloor.section: Not shown in Settings UI (set elsewhere, e.g. the SQL Quality report view)
qualityFloor.description: The minimum severity a quality report renders; findings less severe than this floor are hidden ('info' shows everything).

qualityShowPassed.label: (not surfaced in SettingsModal)
qualityShowPassed.section: Not shown in Settings UI (set elsewhere, e.g. the SQL Quality report view)
qualityShowPassed.description: Shows the quality checks that passed, at any detail level.

serverLog.label: Write a per-connection server activity log
serverLog.description: Mirrors session logs to each connection's log_dir (set in the connection editor); applies to newly opened sessions, appending to <dir>/<connection>.log.

queryWarnings.label: Fetch server warnings
queryWarnings.description: Fetches MySQL server warnings (SHOW WARNINGS) after write-family statements, at the cost of an extra roundtrip on writes.

prodRowCap.label: Prod row cap
prodRowCap.description: Soft row cap that replaces the default LIMIT on prod sessions; the status-bar override still wins, and 0 turns it off.

connectTimeoutSecs.label: Connect timeout
connectTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait, in seconds, for a server to answer before giving up; a connection's own Advanced connect timeout still overrides it. Pushed to the backend so it applies to connections without their own timeout.

editorInvisibles.label: (not surfaced in SettingsModal)
editorInvisibles.section: Not shown in Settings UI (toggled elsewhere, e.g. an editor View control)
editorInvisibles.description: Renders whitespace (spaces, tabs and trailing whitespace) in the editor, like Notepad++'s Show Symbol.

editorZoom.label: (not surfaced in SettingsModal)
editorZoom.section: Not shown in Settings UI (adjusted via editor zoom commands)
editorZoom.description: Per-editor font zoom in percent, independent of the app-wide font size.

editorRulers.label: (not surfaced in SettingsModal)
editorRulers.section: Not shown in Settings UI (set elsewhere)
editorRulers.description: Vertical right-margin guides drawn at the given character columns (like VS Code's editor.rulers); an empty list turns them off.
editorRulers.values: comma-separated list of positive column numbers; empty list = off

queryTimeoutSecs.label: Query timeout
queryTimeoutSecs.description: Client-side deadline, in seconds, that kills a query running longer than this; a connection's own Advanced query timeout still wins, and 0 means no deadline. Enforced client-side (issues the same KILL as the Stop button) so it covers writes too, unlike MySQL's max_execution_time.
queryTimeoutSecs.values: integer seconds; 0 = off; stepper ranges 0 to 3600 in steps of 15

beepOnLongQuery.label: Beep when a long-running query finishes
beepOnLongQuery.description: Plays a sound when a query that ran at least the long-query threshold finishes (rising on success, falling on failure), so you can tell what happened from another window.

longQueryBeepSecs.label: Long-running query is
longQueryBeepSecs.description: How long a query must run, in seconds, before its completion is worth a beep; queries faster than this never beep.
longQueryBeepSecs.values: integer seconds; stepper ranges 1 to 3600 in steps of 5

sqlDelimiter.label: Statement delimiter
sqlDelimiter.description: The statement terminator used to split a script into statements; almost always ';'. A MySQL DELIMITER directive inside the script still overrides it from that line on, and leaving it empty resets it to ';'.

scriptErrorMode.label: On a failed statement
scriptErrorMode.description: What happens when a statement fails partway through a multi-statement run: prompt (ignore, ignore all, or stop) or abort the run outright marking the rest skipped.

interactiveKill.label: Interactive kill
interactiveKill.description: Offers one-click kill controls (kill query / kill connection) on the process list; turn it off to make the process list a read-only monitor.

aiProvider.label: Provider
aiProvider.description: Which AI backend the editor's generate-SQL, explain and Fix-with-AI actions use.

aiBaseUrl.label: Endpoint base URL
aiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI endpoint the API key is sent to.

aiModel.label: Model
aiModel.description: The model name requested from the AI provider.
aiModel.values: free-text model id (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5 or gpt-4o)

keepAlive.label: Keep connections alive
keepAlive.description: Pings open sessions periodically and again on window focus, so a pool dropped during sleep or a VPN blip is re-established before your next query hits a dead socket.
